connectFailed: Couldn’t join the network. Check the password and that it’s in range.
connectUnsupported: This device can’t join Wi-Fi networks from apps.
qrWarning: Anyone who can see the screen, or a camera pointed at it, can read this.
confirmBody: This code shows a secret. Confirm with your device lock or your master password first.
scanUnknown: This code isn’t a Wi-Fi network, one-time code or contact.
scanUnsupported: The camera scanner isn’t available on this device.
linkCodeBody: A website or app opened Octa Pass with this code. Add it only if you were setting it up, then choose which login it joins.
linkExportBody: Octa Pass was opened with a Google Authenticator export. Add it only if you started the export, then choose which login each code joins.
linkUnknown: This link isn’t a one-time code Octa Pass can add.
otherAppsHelp: Move your passwords, passkeys and one-time codes to or from another password manager on this phone, without a file.
exportToAppHelp: Pick the app in the system’s list. Files attached to items stay in Octa Pass.
exportToAppConfirm: Enter your master password to export your vault. The other app gets everything in it, unencrypted.
importFromAppHelp: In the other app (for example Settings → Apps → Passwords), choose Export Data to Another App, then Octa Pass.
otherAppsHelpMac: Move your passwords, passkeys and one-time codes to or from another password manager on this Mac, without a file.
importFromAppHelpMac: In the other app (for example the Passwords app), choose Export Data to Another App, then Octa Pass.
autoFillHelp: Fill passwords, passkeys and one-time codes in other apps and websites.
autoFillOn: On: Octa Pass fills in apps and websites.
autoFillOff: Off. Turn it on to fill from Octa Pass.
autoFillCodes: Set up codes in Octa Pass
autoFillCodesHelp: Open one-time code links and QR codes in Octa Pass: choose Octa Pass under Set Up Codes In.
autoFillPasskeysOff: Off. Turn on Octa Pass in Passwords, passkeys & accounts to use your passkeys in apps.
autoFillPrompt: Turn on AutoFill to fill passwords and codes from Octa Pass.
transferHelp: Move your items between Octa Pass and other password managers on this phone, like Google Password Manager.
transferImportHelp: Pick the app on the next screen. You’ll see what it sends before anything is saved.
transferExportHelp: In the other app, choose to import, then pick Octa Pass. You’ll confirm with your master password.
receivedBody: These go into your Personal vault.
receivedCodes_one: {count} one-time code joins a login you already have.
receivedCodes_other: {count} one-time codes join logins you already have.
receivedAgain: {updated} already in your vault will be updated, {unchanged} are unchanged.
receivedNothing: {app} didn’t send anything Octa Pass can import.

native.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening, close and reopen Octa Pass.
native.unlockUnsupported: Set up a screen lock on this phone first, then turn this on.
native.watchCodesHelp: While Octa Pass is unlocked on this phone, it sends your watch the next 15 minutes of one-time codes and their item names. Your secrets stay on this phone. Off by default.
native.wearCodesHelp: While Octa Pass is unlocked on this phone, it sends a nearby watch the next 15 minutes of one-time codes and their item names. Your secrets stay on this phone. Off by default.
native.watchConfirmBody: Your watch will show your one-time codes. Confirm with your device lock or your master password first.
native.watchEmptyIos: Open Octa Pass on your iPhone
native.watchEmptyAndroid: Open Octa Pass on your phone
native.watchEmptyHelp: Your watch gets codes while the vault is unlocked there, with Show codes on your watch turned on in Settings.
native.watchNoLock: Set a passcode on this watch
native.watchNoLockHelp: Octa Pass shows codes only on a watch with a passcode.
native.watchNoLockHelpAndroid: Octa Pass shows codes only on a watch with a screen lock.
native.watchNoCodes: No one-time codes in your vault
native.nfcWarning: A tag isn’t encrypted: anyone who taps or reads it gets the network’s name and password. Put it where only your guests can reach it.
native.nfcHold: Hold the back of your phone against the tag.
native.nfcDone: Written. Guests with an Android phone tap the tag and confirm to join. iPhones don’t join from a tag.
native.nfcTooSmall: That tag is too small for this network.
native.nfcReadOnly: That tag is locked and can’t be written.
native.nfcFailed: The tag couldn’t be written. Hold it still and try again.
native.nfcUnsupported: This network can’t go on a tag. WEP, WPA3-only and Enterprise networks don’t join by tapping.
native.nfcOff: Turn on NFC in your phone’s settings first.
native.safesInFiles: Open Safes show up in the Files app, and in any app’s file picker, while your vault is unlocked. When it locks, they’re gone from there.
native.safesLockInBackground: Octa Pass locks when you leave it, so your Safes close as soon as you switch to the Files app. You can change this in Settings.
native.safesUseFiles: Add, open and change a Safe’s files in the Files app, under Octa Pass.
native.safesFilesCopies: Files keeps copies of the files you open there until your vault locks. Your Safes close in Files when Octa Pass would auto-lock, counted from when you last used the app.
native.safesInFinder: Open Safes show up in Finder, under Locations, and in any app’s Open and Save windows, while your vault is unlocked. When it locks, they’re gone from there.
native.safesLockInBackgroundMac: Octa Pass locks when you switch away, so your Safes close as soon as you go to Finder. You can change this in Settings.
native.safesUseFinder: Add, open and change a Safe’s files in Finder, under Locations.
native.safesFinderCopies: Finder keeps copies of the files you open there until your vault locks. Your Safes close in Finder when Octa Pass would auto-lock, counted from when you last used the app.
native.safeIntoItself: A folder can’t go inside itself.
native.safeDeleteSelected: Delete the selected items from this Safe? This can’t be undone.
native.safesUnlockFirst: Unlock Octa Pass to open your Safes here.
native.settingsUnlockFirst: Unlock Octa Pass to change its settings.

mac.unlockFailed: Not unlocked. Try again, or open Octa Pass and use your master password.
mac.browserHelp: Lets the Octa Pass extension in Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox unlock through this app, so you don’t type your master password in the browser.
mac.browserNone: No supported browser was found. Install Chrome, Edge, Brave or Firefox, then try again.
mac.bridgeFailed: The extension can’t reach this app: {error}
